cutoff: Data published or observed by 2026-10-14; trade observations use calendar 2024 where returned; BIS claims use end-2026-Q1.
tradeMethod: Bilateral merchandise exports (not services/value added) are reported by origin using one measure, primaryValue, in current USD for UN Comtrade where available. Swiss/EU input share is kept as a distinct structural proxy, not converted to annual gross bilateral trade. No flow is imputed from a missing mirror.

financialMethod: BIS CBS selected gross consolidated international claims, all currencies converted to USD equivalent, all sectors/instruments/maturities, immediate-counterparty basis. Banker nationality and counterparty residence are explicitly distinct. No causal multipliers or net positions are inferred.

alternativesSearched.status: 12 focused directed 2024 export requests; all HTTP 200. Four returned one observation (US→China, China→US, EU27→US, EU27→China); eight returned count=0 for requested combinations that included Switzerland or US→EU. Raw JSON retained.
alternativesSearched.use: Primary official alternative; supports bounded observed pair flows and explicit no-return states.

alternativesSearched.status: One query with nonexistent UNIT dimension returned HTTP 400. A valid US partner request returned data (exports/imports/balance), but raw response was not persisted; a later partner multi-select query returned HTTP 200 with no selected partner cells. No Eurostat value is used. Dataset metadata says last update 2026-09-15.
alternativesSearched.use: Strong EU-only bilateral alternative; do not use successful transient output without archived response.

alternativesSearched.source: Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (Swiss-Impex / Swiss customs), already mapped source SWISS_EXPORTS_2025
alternativesSearched.status: Accepted regional source verifies 2025 aggregate Swiss goods exports/imports; no partner-specific records are in the canonical extract. UN Comtrade partner requests for Swiss reporter 756 returned HTTP 200, count=0. No bilateral value is inserted.
alternativesSearched.use: Strong national alternative for Swiss bilateral merchandise tables; current closure has no extracted partner value.

financialAlternatives.source: BIS Consolidated Banking Statistics (CBS) API v2
financialAlternatives.status: One fresh 2026-Q1 multi-series query returned seven numeric rows, all FR/GB reporters. US, China and Swiss rows and CN counterparty rows did not appear in selected response.
financialAlternatives.interpretation: Reporter is bank nationality, counterparty dimension is residence, basis is immediate counterparty. Non-return is not zero; missing firms/reporters and domestic credit are not imputed.

financialAlternatives.source: SAFE International Investment Position (IIP), national residence basis
financialAlternatives.status: Accepted China regional source exists; this table is country external stock, not bank nationality.
financialAlternatives.interpretation: Do not substitute country-level IIP for BIS bank claims or infer immediate bilateral bank exposure.

financialAlternatives.source: IMF IIP/CPIS and national SNB/BEA external accounts
financialAlternatives.status: Global bundle maps the official datasets, but current closure did not extract a matched four-region partner/currency/maturity panel.
financialAlternatives.interpretation: Strong alternatives for residence-based positions/portfolio positions; partner coverage and revisions differ, and current matched matrix remains unavailable.

coverageAssessment: Materialized bounded comparison: US-China two-way reported exports; EU27-origin reported exports to US and China; a separate lagged Swiss-EU intermediate-input share; seven BIS nationality-to-residence gross-claim edges. Complete US/China/EU/Swiss bilateral trade and financial matrices remain unavailable from this bounded extract. Swiss Comtrade pair queries returned no rows; three official alternatives and query outcomes are recorded. Missing entries are null/status-coded, never zero.
